========================================== # 配置区域 # ========================================== # 目标URL BASE_URL = "https://www.centralbank.org.bz" START_URL = "https://www.centralbank.org.bz/publications-search" # 爬取数量限制 (根据任务目标：前5条) MAX_ITEMS = 5 # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # 浏览器配置 USER_AGENT = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" VIEWPORT = {'width': 1920, 'height': 1080} # ========================================== # 辅助函数 # ========================================== def ensure_dir(path): if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 修复相对路径图片和链接 2. 移除无用标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): # 忽略 base64 图片 if not img['src'].startswith('data:'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): href = a['href'] if not href.startswith(('http', 'https', 'mailto', 'tel', '#')): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, href) # 移除脚本和样式 for script in soup(["script", "style", "iframe", "noscript"]): script.decompose() return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def is_file_url(url): """判断是否为文件链接""" if not url: return False path = urlparse(url).path.lower() extensions = ['.pdf', '.doc', '.docx', '.xls', '.xlsx', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.zip', '.rar', '.csv'] return any(path.endswith(ext) for ext in extensions) def extract_date(text): """从文本中提取日期""" if not text: return "" # 尝试匹配常见日期格式 # 23 February 2026 match = re.search(r'(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{4})', text) if match: try: date_str = match.group(0) dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%d %B %Y") return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except: pass # February 23, 2026 match = re.search(r'([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}),?\s+(\d{4})', text) if match: try: date_str = match.group(0) # 移除逗号 date_str = date_str.replace(',', '') dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%B %d %Y") return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except: pass # YYYY-MM-DD match = re.search(r'(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})', text) if match: return match.group(0) return "" # ========================================== # 核心爬虫逻辑 # ========================================== def crawl_detail_page(page, url): """爬取详情页内容""" print(f"正在抓取详情页: {url}") # 如果是文件链接，直接返回链接 if is_file_url(url): print(f"检测到文件链接，跳过正文提取: {url}") return { "content": f'Download File', "date": "" # 文件链接通常没有详情页日期 } try: page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) page.wait_for_timeout(1500) # 等待动态内容加载 # 提取日期 (如果列表页没取到，尝试在详情页找) date_text = "" # 尝试多个可能的日期选择器 date_selectors = [ ".item-list__date.detail-page p", ".item-list__date", ".article-date", "time", ".interior-layout__title + div", "div.date", "span.date" ] for sel in date_selectors: if page.locator(sel).count() > 0: date_text = page.locator(sel).first.inner_text().strip() if extract_date(date_text): break # 提取正文 content_html = "" # 尝试定位主要内容区域 content_selectors = [ "div.group.margin-large", ".article-content", ".news-detail", "#main-content", "#top" ] for sel in content_selectors: if page.locator(sel).count() > 0: content_html = page.locator(sel).first.inner_html() break if not content_html: content_html = page.content() # 兜底 # 清洗内容 cleaned_content = clean_html_content(content_html, url) return { "content": cleaned_content, "date": extract_date(date_text) } except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 详情页抓取失败 {url}: {e}") return {"content": "", "date": ""} def crawl_news(): ensure_dir(OUTPUT_DIR) with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=True, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport=VIEWPORT, user_agent=USER_AGENT, ignore_https_errors=True ) page = context.new_page() articles = [] current_page = 1 try: # 访问列表页 print(f"访问首页: {START_URL}") page.goto(START_URL, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=60000) while len(articles) < MAX_ITEMS: print(f"正在处理第 {current_page} 页...") # === 修复：使用更健壮的选择器策略 === # 尝试多种可能的列表项选择器，而不是硬编码一个 item_selectors = [ "ul.item-list li.item-list__item", # 原有 ".search-results .result", # 通用搜索结果 ".sf_colsOut", # Sitefinity CMS 常见 "table tr", # 表格布局 ".news-item", # 通用新闻项 "div.item", # 通用项 ".list-group-item" # Bootstrap ] items = [] active_selector = "" # 遍历选择器，找到第一个返回有效数据的 for sel in item_selectors: try: candidates = page.locator(sel).all() # 过滤：必须包含可见的 A 标签，且文本长度足够（排除空行/表头） valid_candidates = [] for c in candidates: if c.is_visible() and c.locator("a").count() > 0: if len(c.inner_text().strip()) > 10: valid_candidates.append(c) if len(valid_candidates) > 0: items = valid_candidates active_selector = sel print(f"使用选择器 '{sel}' 找到 {len(items)} 条数据") break except Exception: continue # 兜底策略：如果常规选择器都失败，尝试在主内容区查找所有链接 if not items: print("常规选择器未找到，尝试通用链接提取...") main_area = page.locator("main, #content, #main, .container, body").first if main_area.count() > 0: links = main_area.locator("a").all() for link in links: if len(items) >= MAX_ITEMS * 2: break # 限制数量 txt = link.inner_text().strip() href = link.get_attribute("href") # 简单的启发式过滤：文本较长，且链接有效 if len(txt) > 15 and href and not href.startswith(("#", "javascript")): items.append(link) # 这里 item 就是 link 元素本身 print(f"当前页有效新闻项数: {len(items)}") if not items: print("当前页无数据，停止翻页") break for item in items: if len(articles) >= MAX_ITEMS: break try: # === 通用提取逻辑 === # 1. 提取标题和链接 # 如果 item 本身是 A 标签 tag_name = item.evaluate("el => el.tagName").lower() if tag_name == "a": title_el = item else: # 否则查找内部的 A 标签 # 优先找标题类的 A 标签 title_el = item.locator("h2 a, h3 a, h4 a, .title a, a.item-list__title").first if not title_el.count(): title_el = item.locator("a").first if not title_el.is_visible(): continue title = title_el.inner_text().strip() link = title_el.get_attribute("href") if link: link = urljoin(BASE_URL, link) # 2. 提取摘要 (仅当 item 是容器时) summary = "" if tag_name != "a": # 尝试提取除标题外的文本 full_text = item.inner_text() summary = full_text.replace(title, "").strip()[:200] # 简单截取 # 3. 提取列表页日期 date_str = "" if tag_name != "a": # 尝试在文本中查找日期 date_str = extract_date(item.inner_text()) print(f"发现新闻: {title}") # 初始化文章对象 article = { "id": str(len(articles) + 1), "title": title, "sourceUrl": link, "summary": summary, "source": "Central Bank of Belize", "author": "", "date": date_str, "content": "" } # 进入详情页抓取 if link: detail_page = context.new_page() detail_data = crawl_detail_page(detail_page, link) detail_page.close() article["content"] = detail_data.get("content", "") # 优先使用详情页日期 if detail_data.get("date"): article["date"] = detail_data["date"] # 兜底日期 if not article["date"]: # 尝试从摘要中再次提取 article["date"] = extract_date(summary) articles.append(article) print(f"已采集: {title} ({article['date']})") time.sleep(random.uniform(1, 2)) except Exception as e: print(f"处理单条新闻时出错: {e}") continue if len(articles) >= MAX_ITEMS: print(f"已达到目标数量 {MAX_ITEMS}，停止采集") break # 翻页逻辑 (尝试通用翻页按钮) next_btn = page.locator('ul.pagination li a:has-text("»"), a:has-text("Next"), a:has-text("next")').first if next_btn.count() > 0 and next_btn.is_visible(): print("正在跳转下一页...") next_url = next_btn.get_attribute("href") if next_url: full_next_url = urljoin(BASE_URL, next_url) page.goto(full_next_url, wait_until="networkidle") current_page += 1 time.sleep(2) else: # 可能是 JS 按钮 next_btn.click() page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle") current_page += 1 else: print("未找到下一页按钮，停止翻页") break except Exception as e: print(f"[Critical] 爬虫运行出错: {e}") finally: browser.close() return articles def save_results(articles): """保存结果为JSON""" timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"centralbank_belize_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "articles": articles } try: with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"结果已保存至: {output_path}") except Exception as e: print(f"保存文件失败: {e}") def main(): print("=== 开始爬取伯利兹中央银行新闻 ===") articles = crawl_news() if articles: save_results(articles) print(f"爬取完成，共获取 {len(articles)} 条数据") else: print("未获取到任何数据") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
